metadata.author: Jeff Brown
metadata.description:
Stanley Lambchop is a nice, average boy. Then one day a bulletin board falls on him, and suddenly Stanley is flat. So begins Flat Stanley, the first in a series of very funny, very unusual adventures starring Stanley Lambchop. 

In Invisible Stanley, a storm renders Stanley invisible, allowing him to play matchmaker, go on television, and fight crime. Stanley in Space tells the story of Stanley’s explorations of Star Scout, the new top-secret spaceship. In Stanley, Flat Again, Stanley uses his unusual dimensions to save a girl trapped in a collapsed building.
